name: synthetic-error-participants
description: The paging endpoint under a rate limit — a 429 that a caller should retry against `Retry-After`, not treat as a failed page. Vendor non-2xx is DATA: the engine classifies it as a provider error, forces zero usage, and passes the envelope through — `code` is the stable half a caller branches on. Authored from the GrowSurf REST v2 (2.0.0) response shape, verified field for field against a live deployment on 2026-09-22; the identities are GrowSurf's own published example values.

body.name: RateLimitError
body.message: Too many requests. Retry after the period given by Retry-After.
